title: packet range: Add an iterator
description:
Add a packet range iterator structure and use it to abstract away some
of the details in process_specified_records. This is necessary but not
sufficient for #14887 and #16188. (packet_range_t would need to support
orderings other than sequential.)

Also get rid of some redundant packet_range_process_init calls.

AI-Assisted: no
